sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by direct curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed the <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = tier letter, then each <span class="tier-list-entry"> block's FIRST img alt = "Spec Class", which correctly ignores the spell-icon alts inside the expandable details blocks). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page. Era-verified per <title>: "Midnight DPS Rankings: Raiding Tier List (Midnight (12.0.7))", "...(Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1)" and siblings; Devourer present in both DPS lists; 0 "Season 2" hits. The pages' OWN dates are unchanged and still trail our fetch: JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-01 (raid DPS), 2026-06-30 (raid healer/tank), 2026-07-01 (all three M+) — so this is a live re-verification of a static upstream list, not new editorial movement. 0 tier moves vs committed.

All 3 PTR M+ pages fetched live (dps/healer/tank), HTTP 200, 221-357 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)", never Season 1. The page's own date is unchanged — JSON-LD dateModified 2026-07-26T10:53 on all three — so sources.json published stays 2026-07-26 while snapshot (our fetch cadence) advances to 2026-08-01; upstream rebuilds Sundays 14:00 CEST, so a 6-day lag is the documented normal and not yet the ~2-week freeze that would be a finding. Six-band scale seen intact (S/A+/A/B+/B/C; B+ present on the DPS and healer pages). 40 rows written: 38 rated + the 2 upstream TBDs kept as EXPLICIT nulls — Augmentation Evoker (DPS page TBD row) and Vengeance Demon Hunter (tank page TBD row), both re-confirmed in this fetch rather than assumed. 0 tier moves. Never enters the consensus (era-gated in the registry).

Both pages fetched live by direct curl, HTTP 200 (149 KB raid / 161 KB M+). Parsed the tier__tier blocks (tier__title letter + data-original-title spec names, each block bounded at the next tier__tier). Era-verified: 3 "Season 1" and 6 "Midnight" hits on the raid page, 2 "Season 1" and 10 "Midnight" on the M+ page, 0 "Season 2" hits on either. Raid 39 rows (Vengeance DH still omitted upstream — the longstanding absence, not a parse loss) + M+ 40 = 79, 0 unmatched. The 8 rejected strings on the M+ page are the dungeon tier list (Windrunner Spire, Pit of Saron, Magister's Terrace, Maisara Caverns, Seat of the Triumvirate, Nexus Point Xenas, Skyreach, Algeth'ar Academy), correctly excluded. 0 tier moves.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, via direct curl carrying the full browser header set (Accept, Accept-Language, sec-ch-ua*, sec-fetch-*, upgrade-insecure-requests). Parsed the [tier-list=rows] block out of the raw document after unescaping \/ to / — note the transport gotcha hit this run: the healer-raid page carries TWO WH.markup.printHtml calls and anchoring on the FIRST one yielded 0 rows; searching the whole unescaped document for the tier-list block instead returned the real 7 healer rows, and the parse was re-run for all six pages that way. 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, M+ DPS A+ tier present (4 specs). Era-verified: every <title> reads "for Midnight Season 1"; 0 "Season 2" occurrences inside the tier block on any page. Raid DPS S tier and several D/F tiers are genuinely empty upstream — same shape as committed. 0 tier moves.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag (specTierListSection.tierLists), raid = the throughput tierList and M+ = score, resolving each entry from its "Class-Spec" icon token. 80 rows, 0 unmatched, no duplicates. Archon has NOT re-stamped since the last run: lastUpdated still reads 2026-07-31T12:00:00Z on all 6 pages (it was already 07-31 yesterday). Titles still read "Midnight ... VS / DR / MQD Tier List" (Season 1 raids) and "Midnight ... Mythic+ Tier List", no Season 2. Total parses 419059 raid DPS / 2591191 M+ DPS. ONE tier move across both brackets: Frost Mage raid S -> A. Worth flagging for a human that the numeric series underneath (see archon-metrics/hps/mplus-score) DID shift slightly against the same unchanged lastUpdated stamp, so that field appears to be a coarse daily label rather than a precise aggregation timestamp — the tier read is taken from the live payload either way.

Full re-fetch of all 9 raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 and every encounter parsing a complete 40/40 specs, so nothing was written from a partial page (the merge refuses any encounter under 40 specs). Each page's selectedEncounter was checked against the requested slug — 17/17 matched, so no silent redirect to an aggregate view. 680 tier cells written, 36 changed, all one band and confined to 8 encounters: imperator (15 cells, a broad upward reshuffle), vorasius (6), vaelgor-ezzorak (4), beloren (6), midnight-falls (3), vanguard (1), crown (1). No new or retired encounters. asOf advanced to 2026-08-01.

Survivability tierList re-parsed from all 3 raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, merged via the apply-metrics survivability key. Same code path and same tierLists array as the throughput parse. 0 cells moved this run (yesterday's 6 upward moves held), which is the honest outcome of a re-parse against an unchanged lastUpdated stamp. 40 rows against a floor of 25.

Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows (27 raid DPS + 6 tanks; the healer page also exposes a dps column but healer damage stays deliberately excluded, matching the committed series shape), each carrying n = that row's parses count, values rounded from the raw float. Range 89690-183284 (was 89132-182868), i.e. the numbers DID move slightly even though page lastUpdated still reads 2026-07-31T12:00:00Z — recorded rather than smoothed over. Every single-row move across the whole Archon numeric set was far below the gate's maxValueMovePct. 33 rows against a floor of 25.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, values rounded. Range 186159-214702 (was 185643-213453) — a small uniform drift, consistent with the aggregate window rolling forward under an unchanged lastUpdated label. 7 rows against a floor of 5.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses. Range 3396-4256, unchanged endpoints from the last run. 40 rows against a floor of 25.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention, and merged with no hold-back. Ran the shape check that caught the three-night raid-half corruption: every value is a plausible percentage (range 0.5-38.4 across both brackets), none carries a DPS magnitude, and no row equals its spec's 95th-pct DPS value. 80 rows against a floor of 60.

Fetched correctly via the JSON API, never the stale HTML prerender: manifest.json + rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200, plain curl, no proxy. 44 blocks in the rankings file; whitelisted categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField == lowerBound AND keyRange undefined -> 27+7+6 = 40 rows, className/spec byte-identical to the roster, 0 unmatched, no melee/ranged double-count. PARTIAL, not success, because the upstream snapshotDate is STILL 2026-07-28 (now unchanged for a fourth day) and asOf is the SOURCE's date, never today — so the stored coverage date cannot honestly be claimed as fresh. All 40 lowerBound values are byte-identical to committed at the stored 2-decimal precision, consistent with an unchanged upstream snapshot. The real staleness alarm is maxAgeDays 8; at 4 days old it is not yet firing, but a human should note it is now halfway there. Published letters remain deliberately un-ingested.

40/40 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) by plain GET on the three /meta/<role>/m+ pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok). Parsed by segmenting the document between consecutive meta-item anchor OPENING TAGS and reading each block's second .h3 (the spec name; the first is the rank) plus the first number after its </svg> — the per-anchor segmentation the skill mandates, since a fixed-size window silently yields 28/40. Alignment independently cross-checked against each anchor's href slug (/<class>/<spec>/m+): 40/40 matched, 0 mismatches, 0 unmatched names. Era-verified "Midnight Season 1" in all three titles, 0 "Season 2" hits. The pages re-aggregate every 8 hours and have moved modestly: 11 of 40 values changed, max 0.60%.

Best-build DPS read from data.MID1 at target counts 1/2/3/5/8/15. Still weekly period 1074, week 19 (MID1; Lindormi's Guidance, Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour, Fortified, Tyrannical, Xal'atath's Guile) and the counters have NOT moved: top 2000 keys / 10000 characters (5080 unique) / 21.3 average key level, so all 39 charted values are unchanged — a live re-verification, not new data. The family holds 40 rows of which 39 are fresh; coverage (floor 25) is 2026-08-01. No season flip.
